iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max bring quite a few new changes to the main camera and the iOS camera app, and photographer Austin Mann has just published an excellent review detailing all the new features.

Austin Mann publishes in-depth review of iPhone 18 Pro camera upgrades

Every year, photographer Austin Mann publishes an in-depth review of the new camera features on the iPhone—of course with plenty of beautiful photos attached.

Mann's iPhone 18 Pro camera upgrade review was published today, and it's highly recommended that you check it out for a one-stop overview of the new features and the kinds of photos they can capture.

Speaking about the newly added variable aperture feature, Mann says:

He shared several beautiful photos showcasing how the all-new larger aperture on the iPhone 18 Pro captures the night sky over Colorado.

Regarding the new Pro-grade controls exclusive to the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, Mann is particularly excited about discovering the manual focus feature:

When introducing Photographic Styles 3, other reviewers such as Tyler Stalman have specifically mentioned the ability to give photos a film-like quality. Mann feels the same way and offers the following tips to help you capture the best film-like feel:

  • "Shoot slightly darker, for example -1.0, and use the largest aperture f/1.48 to shoot. Use manual focus, so the image will be slightly softer (which is actually fine!)."
  • "Choose HEIF format to shoot, so you can apply Photographic Styles."
  • "Then during post-production, use the D-Pad to move the dot to the bottom-right corner, which can reduce tone-mapping (i.e., the HDR effect), compress the shadows, and push the highlights."
  • "You can lower the Film effect intensity to reduce halation, otherwise it can sometimes be too over-the-top."

You can watch Austin Mann's video review below.

Mann's full review also covers features such as Focus Tracking, Apple Reference Image, and 4K time-lapse photography.

Check out Austin Mann's full iPhone 18 Pro camera review here.
